description.tr: Ortaçağ dünyasının en büyük kütüphanelerinden birini (II. Hakem döneminde 400.000 cilt) yönetirken matematikçi olarak tanındı || II. Hakem döneminde Kurtuba kütüphanesi Avrupa'nın en büyüğüydü. || [Tarih notu] Kaynaklar ayrıntılarda farklılık gösterir.
description.en: Managed one of the largest libraries in the medieval world (400,000 volumes under al-Hakam II) while being renowned as a mathematician — a rare female intellectual at the peak of Andalusian civilization || The Córdoba library under al-Hakam II was the largest in Europe. Labana's role as its custodian and her mathematical reputation suggest she was more than a copyist — she was a scholarly curator. || [Historiographical note] Sources vary on details. Some modern scholars question the scale of the library; others note that even conservative estimates make it exceptional. Labana's mathematical expertise is more consistently attested.
